Information.Description: Dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate is a steroid sulfate that is the 3-sulfooxy derivative of dehydroepiandrosterone. It has a role as a mouse metabolite, an EC 2.7.1.33 (pantothenate kinase) inhibitor and a human metabolite. It is a steroid sulfate and a 17-oxo steroid. It is functionally related to a dehydroepiandrosterone. It is a conjugate acid of a dehydroepiandrosterone sulfate(1-).
